inclusion.I1: Empirical English-language structural MRI studies comparing TLE patients against a control group using a VOXEL-WISE method (VBM, voxel-based morphometry, SPM voxelwise analysis). ROI-only or atlas/parcellation-only designs (FreeSurfer region tables, manual hippocampal volumetry) do NOT qualify, because they report per-region values rather than the stereotactic coordinates a coordinate-based meta-analysis requires.
inclusion.I2: The study must report, or make determinable, the side of the seizure focus (left, right, or both/mixed). Studies of unspecified laterality still qualify at abstract stage; laterality is resolved at full text.
inclusion.I3: Mesial temporal sclerosis, hippocampal sclerosis and medial temporal lobe epilepsy all qualify as TLE.

exclusion.E1: Reviews, meta-analyses, case reports, and studies of a single patient.
exclusion.E2: Purely functional studies (fMRI, PET, MEG, EEG) with no structural morphometric outcome.
exclusion.E3: ROI-based or atlas-based-only morphometry with no voxel-wise whole-brain analysis.
exclusion.E4: Studies only of post-surgical change with no patient-versus-control comparison.

inclusion.I4: Reports coordinates in a standard stereotactic space (MNI or Talairach) for at least one patient-versus-control structural contrast.
inclusion.I5: The seizure-focus side of the patient sample is stated or clearly determinable.
inclusion.I6: Whole-brain or whole-region analysis; ROI-only hippocampal volumetry without coordinates does NOT qualify.

exclusion.E7: Coordinates reported only for functional or diffusion measures, not grey matter structure.
exclusion.E8: Patient group is not TLE, or is a mixed epilepsy sample where TLE cannot be isolated.

inclusion.GLOBAL_I1: Judge each analysis from its own name, description and table caption, plus the study text for the seizure-focus side. An empty or generic analysis name is never itself a reason to exclude.
inclusion.GLOBAL_I2: Coordinates must be in MNI or Talairach space.

exclusion.GLOBAL_E1: Exclude analyses that are not a patient-versus-control structural comparison.

inclusion.LEFT_TLE_ATROPHY_I1: The patient sample has a LEFT-sided seizure focus (left TLE, left MTS, left hippocampal sclerosis). If the paper reports left and right groups separately, this label applies only to the left-focus contrast.
inclusion.LEFT_TLE_ATROPHY_I2: The contrast direction is controls GREATER than patients, i.e. atrophy / reduced grey matter / reduced volume in patients.

exclusion.LEFT_TLE_ATROPHY_E2: Patients GREATER than controls (hypertrophy or increased volume).
exclusion.LEFT_TLE_ATROPHY_E3: Contrasts between two patient groups rather than patients versus controls.

inclusion.RIGHT_TLE_ATROPHY_I1: The patient sample has a RIGHT-sided seizure focus (right TLE, right MTS, right hippocampal sclerosis). If left and right groups are reported separately, this label applies only to the right-focus contrast.
inclusion.RIGHT_TLE_ATROPHY_I2: The contrast direction is controls GREATER than patients.

exclusion.RIGHT_TLE_ATROPHY_E3: Contrasts between two patient groups rather than patients versus controls.

inclusion.ALL_TLE_ATROPHY_I1: Any TLE patient sample (left, right, bilateral or unspecified) versus controls.
inclusion.ALL_TLE_ATROPHY_I2: The contrast direction is controls GREATER than patients.

exclusion.ALL_TLE_ATROPHY_E2: Contrasts between two patient groups rather than patients versus controls.
